name: Classic Polo
desc: Crafted from premium cotton with a tailored silhouette. Designed for everyday elegance, durability and comfort.

details.material:
Cut from 220 GSM GOTS-certified organic cotton piqué, grown without synthetic pesticides and dyed with low-impact, OEKO-TEX certified pigments.

The open-knit weave breathes in heat and holds its shape wash after wash — a polo built for a decade, not a season.
details.design:
A tailored silhouette with a clean, ribless placket and genuine mother-of-pearl buttons. The collar is double-stitched to stand naturally without fusing.

Side vents and a slightly dropped back hem keep it polished untucked — from morning meetings to evening trains.
details.care:
Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colours. Lay flat to dry to preserve the collar's structure.

Warm iron if needed; avoid bleach and tumble drying to keep the piqué's texture crisp.

name: Tailored Shirt
desc: A structured shirt in fine cotton poplin, finished with mother-of-pearl buttons.

details.material:
Fine organic cotton poplin, spun from extra-long staple fibres for a smooth, cool hand and a soft natural sheen.

Traceable from farm to mill, with every dye bath meeting strict wastewater standards.
details.design:
A structured semi-cutaway collar, single-needle stitching at 18 stitches per inch, and a gusseted hem — the quiet signatures of proper shirtmaking.

Cut close through the shoulder with ease through the body, so it moves with you rather than against you.
details.care:
Gentle machine wash at 30°C and hang to dry while still damp — most creases fall out on the hanger.

A medium iron restores the crisp finish; dry clean before important occasions.

name: Wool Overcoat
desc: A double-breasted overcoat in brushed wool, cut for a clean, considered silhouette.

details.material:
A brushed merino wool blend certified to the Responsible Wool Standard, lined in recycled cupro that glides over knitwear.

Naturally insulating, breathable and biodegradable — wool as it should be.
details.design:
Double-breasted with hand-finished lapels, real horn buttons and a gently suppressed waist for a clean, considered line.

Interior security pocket and a locker loop for daily practicality.
details.care:
Dry clean sparingly — once a season is enough. Between wears, brush with a garment brush and air overnight.

Store on a broad cedar hanger to hold the shoulder line and deter moths.

name: Silk Slip Dress
desc: Bias-cut silk dress with a fluid drape and minimal detailing.

details.material:
Bias-cut from Ahimsa "peace" silk, harvested without harming the silkworm, and finished with certified low-impact dyes.

The fabric's natural temperature regulation keeps it cool in summer and soft against the skin year-round.
details.design:
French seams throughout, a scooped back and fine adjustable straps — nothing that doesn't need to be there.

The bias cut lets the silk pour over the body and move with a fluid, unforced drape.
details.care:
Hand wash cold with a silk-specific detergent, or dry clean. Never wring; press water out in a towel.

Drip dry away from direct sun and iron cool on the reverse while slightly damp.

name: Butterfly Tote
desc: Indigo jute under an all-over scatter of white butterflies. An open weave left honest, a print that sits into the grain, and a shape cut to carry a day's worth of things without ceremony.

details.material:
Natural jute in a coarse plain weave, piece-dyed indigo. Jute is a rain-fed bast fibre — fast-growing, fully biodegradable and one of the lowest-impact textiles in production.

The butterflies are printed in white across the whole body, front and back, in a loose repeat that runs right to the seams. Because the ink meets an open weave rather than a flat cloth, it sits into the grain and softens at the edges — textured up close, graphic from across a room.
details.design:
A clean rectangular body with a wide, unfastened opening and a flat base that lets the bag stand on its own. The top edge is turned and bound for structure; side seams are reinforced where the handles take load.

No closure, no hardware, nothing dangling — the print is the only ornament. Long woven handles are set inside the top hem and box-stitched at the stress points, cut with a drop for shoulder carry over a coat.
details.care:
Spot clean with a barely damp cloth and mild soap; do not machine wash or soak, as jute weakens when saturated. Dry flat, away from direct sun.

Store stuffed so the base keeps its shape. A few stray fibres at the seams are natural to jute and can simply be trimmed.

name: Structured Satchel
desc: A boxy top-handle satchel in vegetable-tanned leather with brass hardware.

details.material:
Vegetable-tanned cowhide with a suede-lined flap underside, tanned slowly for structure that softens without slouching.

All offcuts from our satchel production are returned to the tannery for regrind — nothing is wasted.
details.design:
A boxy East-West profile with saddle-stitched stress points — each stitch locked independently, so a worn thread never runs.

Solid brass roller buckle and a reinforced base that stands on its own.
details.care:
Wipe with a barely damp cloth and condition twice a year. Avoid overfilling to keep the silhouette sharp.

Rest it in its dust bag between heavy use.

name: Weekender Duffel
desc: Canvas and leather duffel built for short trips, with a detachable shoulder strap.

details.material:
18 oz organic cotton canvas with full-grain leather trim and webbing woven from a high-grade jute blend — durable, breathable and fully biodegradable.

The canvas is loomed dense enough to shrug off drizzle without any plastic coating.
details.design:
Built for the two-night trip: a detachable, adjustable shoulder strap, riveted stress points and solid brass feet that keep the base off the floor.

Wide-mouth opening so you can actually see what you packed.
details.care:
Spot clean the canvas with mild soap; condition the leather trim as you would a bag.

Air-dry fully before storing, and stuff lightly to hold the shape.

name: Leather Belt
desc: A 3cm leather belt with a solid brass buckle, hand-finished edges.

details.material:
A single strap of full-grain, vegetable-tanned leather — no splits, no bonded layers — with a solid brass buckle cast, not stamped.

The tannage uses mimosa and quebracho bark, so the strap ages to a warm honey tone.
details.design:
Three centimetres wide with hand-finished, wax-polished edges and five precisely spaced sizing holes.

Designed to sit flat against the waistband — dress trousers or raw denim alike.
details.care:
Condition lightly when the leather feels dry; buff with a soft cloth to restore lustre.

Roll, don't fold, when travelling.

name: Silk Pocket Square
desc: Hand-rolled hem silk square, printed in small batches.

details.material:
Pure mulberry silk twill, screen-printed in small batches and finished with a hand-rolled hem — an hour of handwork per square.

Printed with water-based inks in a certified low-impact studio.
details.design:
A 32 cm square, sized to fold cleanly into a presidential, puff or point — and to stay put once placed.

The twill weave gives the print depth and a soft, tactile lustre.
details.care:
Dry clean only. Store flat or loosely rolled to protect the hand-rolled edge.

A cool iron on the reverse revives the fold lines.

name: Aviator Sunglasses
desc: Acetate aviators with polarised lenses and a matte finish.

details.material:
Frames milled from bio-acetate — a plant-based acetate derived from cotton and wood pulp — fitted with polarised CR-39 lenses offering full UV400 protection.

Every pair is tumbled for three days in wood chips for a deep, glass-like polish.
details.design:
A classic teardrop profile balanced with five-barrel hinges and hand-set pins — engineering where it matters most.

The bridge is sculpted to sit lightly without pinching through long afternoons.
details.care:
Clean with the supplied microfibre cloth; never dry-wipe grit off the lenses.

Store in the case, and keep away from car dashboards and other high-heat spots that can warp acetate.

name: Six-Panel Cap
desc: Unstructured six-panel cap in washed cotton twill, with a soft crown and a brass slider.

details.material:
Washed cotton twill with a soft, unstructured crown and a cotton sweatband — the kind of cap that gives with wear instead of fighting it.

Brass slider closure; no plastic snapback.
details.design:
A six-panel build with a mid-height crown and a gently pre-curved brim, cut to sit low without swallowing the face.

Tonal stitching and no front logo — the shape does the work.
details.care:
Hand wash cool and reshape while damp; never put a cap through a machine cycle.

Air dry over something round so the crown keeps its form.

name: Corduroy Cap
desc: Fine-wale corduroy cap with a curved brim and a cotton sweatband.

details.material:
Fine-wale cotton corduroy with a brushed hand, lined with a cotton sweatband that sits flat against the forehead.

The nap catches light differently through the day — the colour is never quite flat.
details.design:
A softly structured crown on a curved brim, with a covered button at the crown and a metal slider at the back.

Cut a touch deeper than a summer cap so it works over a winter haircut.
details.care:
Spot clean and brush the nap back into line with a soft brush.

Keep it out of the wash — corduroy flattens permanently once it is soaked and spun.
